settings.image_alt: A film photo washed out by orange light leaks from worn seals
settings.title: Clean & Light Seals
settings.text: Worn light seals let stray light fog your film, like the leak in this photo. We replace the old seals and give the camera a topical cleaning.

settings.image_alt: A camera body with the lens off, showing its sensor
settings.title: Sensor Cleaning
settings.text: Dust on a sensor shows up as the same spots in every frame. We clean it carefully so you're not editing them out later.

settings.image_alt: A Coastal Film Lab staff member holding a film camera at the counter
settings.title: Take-5 Testing & Advice
settings.text: Five minutes with our staff to troubleshoot a camera, film, or shooting problem. We'll tell you if it's worth repairing and where to send it.

settings.image_alt: Instant photo of two Coastal techs working on a camera at the bench
settings.title: One-on-One Training
settings.text: Learn to clean your own camera, change light seals, or just understand how your gear works. New to film or keeping an old camera alive, we'll teach you what we know.

settings.question: Why aren't you offering full repair services anymore?
settings.answer: Honestly, qualified camera techs are about as rare as a unicorn on a skateboard, and full repairs were taking longer than anyone wanted. We're focusing our techs where we can deliver the most value: sourcing and servicing refurbished cameras, plus the in-house services we do best.

settings.question: What if my camera needs more than a Clean & Seal or Sensor Cleaning?
settings.answer: Book a Take-5 appointment. We'll diagnose the issue, tell you whether it's worth fixing, and point you to a repair shop we trust for the work we no longer do in-house.

settings.question: How do refurbished cameras get tested before you sell them?
settings.answer: Every camera passes through our techs. We check shutter speeds, light seals, light meters, autofocus where applicable, and overall cleanliness and function. If it doesn't shoot like it should, we don't sell it.

settings.question: Do refurbished cameras come with a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes. Used cameras and lenses carry a 90-day limited warranty, except gear sold AS-IS. See our grading and warranty policy for what's covered.

settings.question: How long does a Clean & Seal take?
settings.answer: Typical turnaround is about one business week.

settings.question: Do I need an appointment for Take-5?
settings.answer: Yes. Take-5 is in store and by appointment only. Call us or book online.

settings.question: How will you contact me about my service?
settings.answer: We like email, so we'll be emailing you to update you about your service.
